baseline_models.focus_anchor: The placed book, its failure to leave any small or large item, its enumeration, and the denial of wrong.
baseline_models.mechanism: Placement makes the book an operative object; the book-root joins dispersed items and fixes a judgment, while negated leaving and exhaustive enumeration close omission. The final denial of wrong constrains totalization to correct placement rather than overreach.

activation_trace.role: Setting a thing in its assigned place supplies the record's operative placement.
Joining item to item supplies aggregation of dispersed deeds into one record.
Binding proof, decree, or judgment makes the assembled record adjudicative rather than merely descriptive.
Leaving something behind supplies the omission operation explicitly negated of the book.
Enumeration with exhaustive pursuit closes the record across every scale of item.
Putting a thing in the wrong place supplies the placement error denied by the closing clause.

changed_reading.before: A written list happens to contain every deed.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately placed evidentiary object joins dispersed acts, makes them judgment-bearing, and closes both omission and misplacement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: You see the criminals apprehensive, and they find what they intentionally did present.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah moves from visible offenders and apprehension to finding their own intentional acts near and present. The book therefore does not only report an absent past; it mediates an encounter in which the deeds themselves function as present evidence.

activation_trace.role: Sight by eye or insight supplies the opening mode of evidentiary recognition.
Offense and culpability identify the viewers as implicated subjects of the evidence.
Fear mixed with vigilant concern supplies recognition before the verbal complaint.
Actually encountering or hitting upon the thing turns record-reading into discovery.
Intentional action makes the encountered material their own purposive doing.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity collapse the distance between past action and present accounting.

changed_reading.before: The offenders read reports about past deeds.
changed_reading.after: They encounter their own intentional deeds as proximate evidence, so the record re-presents rather than merely describes the past.

context_deltas.mechanism: The movement from flourishing mixture to dry fragments blown apart, then to abiding deeds and gathered people, re-reads the focus book's joining and counting as counter-dispersal. Transient matter loses coherence, but accountable acts and agents are retained and recollected.

activation_trace.role: Dry, broken vegetation supplies the material disintegration that threatens continuity.
Wind-winnowing and scattering supply dispersal that normally defeats retention.
Continuance and remaining supply the contrast class of deeds that endure.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies recollection of dispersed agents.
The focus book's joining operation reassembles deed-items into one accountable whole.
Exhaustive counting prevents scattered fragments from dropping out of recollection.

structural_cues: 18:45 moves from mixture and growth to broken matter scattered by wind, and 18:46 immediately names what remains.
18:47 gathers the people before 18:49 gathers and counts their deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersal, remaining deeds, gathering, and exhaustive counting; I infer that the book functions as counter-dispersal memory. A live alternative is a simple contrast between transient worldly life and lasting reward without a record mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The book preserves information about deeds.
changed_reading.after: The book reverses the surrounding world's dispersal by recollecting agents and deed-fragments into an enduring accountable whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: People are first exposed for inspection and aligned in a row; the book is then placed, the offenders are seen, and their deeds are present. The spatial sequence turns the focus scene into a public audit in which subject, record, and evidence are mutually inspectable.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out for inspection supplies public evidentiary exposure.
Alignment on a level line supplies ordered comparability among those presented.
The book's set placement positions the evidentiary object within the aligned scene.
Seeing makes the persons' response publicly inspectable rather than inward only.
Present and witnessed deeds complete the subject-record-evidence alignment.

structural_cues: The passive presentation of people in 18:48 is followed by the passive placement of the book in 18:49.
Row, placement, seeing, and presence form one spatially ordered sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, linear alignment, placement, sight, and presence; I infer an audit relation in which aligned persons can be matched to present deeds. A live alternative is that the row is ceremonial staging without a comparison function.

changed_reading.before: The book is displayed beside a crowd.
changed_reading.after: The crowd is first aligned for inspection, then the book and present deeds make each subject publicly auditable against the record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence denies successful substitution, witnessing, auxiliary help, reply, and continued partnership. This sharpens the focus phrase 'what they did': the present evidence remains attached to its actors and cannot be transferred to an ally, co-author, helper, or respondent.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in another's place supplies the condemned attempt at substitution.
Denied witnessed presence removes the alleged partners from evidentiary authorship.
Denied helperhood removes auxiliary agency that might share or deflect the account.
The partners' failed reply makes delegated defense unavailable.
A barrier between parties spatially seals the failure of partnership.
Their own intentional doing anchors the present evidence to the actors themselves.

structural_cues: 18:50 calls the chosen allies a bad substitute; 18:51 denies them witness and helper roles.
In 18:52 the called partners neither answer nor remain connected, while 18:49 says the actors find what they themselves did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed substitution, witness, help, response, and connection; I infer a non-transfer rule for agency in the focus record. A live alternative is that these verses reject false allegiance without specifying juridical transfer of responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The record identifies each person's deeds.
changed_reading.after: The record makes agency non-delegable: false allies cannot replace, co-author, support, answer for, or remain joined to the actor's present deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated seeing and finding verbs carry recognition from the placed record to the approaching consequence. Seeing offenders and finding deeds present becomes seeing the fire, expecting its fixed arrival, and finding no turn away; the book is the first threshold in an irreversible encounter sequence.

activation_trace.role: The first act of sight opens recognition at the record.
The first finding makes their deeds an encountered reality.
Presence supplies the causal threshold between recorded past and arriving consequence.
Repeated sight carries recognition from the book to the fire.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the consequence's expected arrival.
Repeated finding, now of no escape route, closes the encounter.
Turning away is negated, making the recognition sequence irreversible.

structural_cues: The sequence mirrors 'you see the criminals' with 'the criminals saw' and 'they found their deeds' with 'they found no diversion.'
Apprehension at the book precedes certainty of encounter and absence of escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored verbs, present deeds, expected falling, and absent diversion; I infer that the record initiates a causal recognition cascade. A live alternative is simple narrative repetition without the book mediating the later encounter.

changed_reading.before: The complete book proves liability before a separate consequence.
changed_reading.after: The placed book begins the same unavoidable encounter that later reaches the fire: sight, finding, fixation, and no turn away form one cascade.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person can lose and abandon the memory of what his hands sent forward, but the book neither leaves it nor merely remembers it abstractly: the work is encountered as present. The focus record therefore externalizes moral memory against self-erasure.

activation_trace.role: Loss of recollection supplies the subject-side deletion that the record reverses.
Sending something ahead supplies temporal displacement of the deed from its actor.
What the hands acquired anchors the forgotten material in embodied agency.
Exhaustive enumeration preserves what subjective memory loses.
Encountering the thing reverses forgetting as an external discovery.
Presence returns the temporally advanced deed to the actor's immediate field.

structural_cues: Both ayat govern the deed with 'what': what the hands sent forward is forgotten, while what they did is found present.
Reminder, turning away, and forgetting in 18:57 oppose non-omission, enumeration, finding, and presence in 18:49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgotten hand-deeds and exhaustive present work; I infer that the book is an external counter-memory. A live alternative is that presence serves only judicial proof and the forgetting contrast is moral rather than mnemonic.

changed_reading.before: The book recalls deeds that offenders may deny.
changed_reading.after: The book defeats self-erasure by returning forgotten, temporally displaced hand-deeds as an immediate encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The complete record does not mechanically produce immediate punishment. Forgiving protection and mercy coexist with an explicitly unrealized acceleration, while the appointment has both a fixed-time branch and a split mapped image of a counted waiting term. The focus denial of wrong can therefore govern timing as well as item-level accuracy.

activation_trace.role: Covering the offense and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies suspended consequence.
Merciful tenderness supplies a non-punitive relation alongside complete knowledge.
Explicitly unrealized acceleration separates evidentiary completeness from immediate execution.
An appointment fixed by time or place bounds when consequence arrives.
The split mapped image of a counted waiting term links appointed timing to the focus's exhaustive count.
Sustaining, repairing, and bringing to completion keep Lordship from collapsing into punitive surveillance.
Denial of wrong placement anchors the inference that consequence is not mistimed.

structural_cues: The unreal conditional says that taking people for what they acquired would have hastened punishment, then corrects to an appointed term.
The same Lord named after the exhaustive record is named forgiving and possessed of mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, non-acceleration, appointment, a counted-term branch, and denial of wrong; I infer that just accounting includes calibrated timing. A live alternative is that mercy only postpones an unchanged sentence and does not alter how 'no wrong' functions in 18:49.

changed_reading.before: Once the exhaustive record is present, punishment follows automatically and at once.
changed_reading.after: Complete evidence coexists with merciful suspension and a counted appointment, so precision governs both what is accounted and when consequence is allowed to arrive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from moral and textual senses into cutting and textile construction. It remains anchored in the focus roots for criminals, book, and placement, whose packet branches supply severing, joining, and cotton set into stitching. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, not as a lexical replacement for 'criminals' or 'book.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The criminals stand before a book that has been placed and that joins every item without omission.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and severing supply a contained material image for the offenders' fragmenting action.
Joining one thing to another supplies the answering operation that reunites separated deed-fragments.
Setting cotton into a sewn garment supplies the form-distant image of a record built by placing and stitching fragments.
Pebbles supply discrete material units that can be gathered, joined, and counted.

changed_reading.before: The book stores offenses committed by criminals.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the offenders' severing is answered by a record that places, stitches, and counts every separated fragment into an unbroken evidentiary fabric.

strongest_changes: The book became a counter-dispersal and counter-forgetting mechanism, not only a store of information.
Presentation in rows, placement, sight, and present deeds formed a public subject-record-evidence audit.
Mirrored seeing and finding made the book the first threshold of an irreversible encounter sequence.
Mercy, non-acceleration, and an appointed counted term prevented exhaustive recording from implying automatic immediate punishment.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest activations came from repeated roots and constructions across 18:47, 18:49, 18:53, 18:57, and 18:58, plus the split mapping of the appointment to both fixed promise-time and counted duration. Focus-only material branches also preserved a contained stitching-and-severance outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The anti-dispersal model may be a contextual contrast rather than a literal function of the record.
The non-transferable agency model may over-juridicize a broader collapse of false allegiance.
The counted-term use of the split appointment root and the stitched-severance model remain exploratory cross-branch activations.
